verdict.rationale: Filing a trade mark or patent with an IP office is the kind of service that could plausibly offer a system-to-system channel, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only human-facing paths: online filing behind a personal One Login account, plus email or post. There is no documented API, system account, transmitter or batch-provider program, and no published enrollment path for software. The 'suite of new digital services' item does not describe any machine channel.
